senses.definition: n.pr.m. (flame of Ēl or my light is Ēl, v. אֵל sub אלה; cf. Ph. ארמלך in Assyrian Urumilki (SenTaylor Cylind. ii. 50, cf. COT 2 K 18:13))
chief of Levit. line of Kohath, in time of David 1 Ch 6:9; 15:5, 11.
maternal grandfather of Abijah 2 Ch 13:2.
